messages:
alyssa: hitting a weird onboarding hang with the sample-app docker quickstart. first call just returns 502 and the console shows 'provisioning workspace' for >5m. anyone seen this?

michael: yep, we've seen sporadic provisioning hangs. backend returns 202 on create and UI waits for billing webhook to flip status. did you create a brand new org or accept an invite into an existing one?

alyssa: brand new org via the guide link. CLI output when I ran `./sample-app start`:

```
POST /api/v1/workspaces -> 202 Accepted
{"id":"wk_1234","status":"pending_provision"}
```

then the app logs show auth errors and a 502 on the first generation call.

ida: pinging infra now. sometimes the billing webhook times out and the workspace stays pending; our auth layer returns 401 until the workspace is active which makes the quickstart look broken. can you paste the container logs?

alyssa: logs: 
```
sample-app_1 | ERROR failed to exchange token: 401 unauthorized
sample-app_1 | INFO retrying auth (1/3)
sample-app_1 | ERROR request failed: 502 Bad Gateway
```

devx-bot: deploy 2026-03-23T10:12:34Z - triggered onboarding-queue retry job_id=job_879 :gear:

michael: thanks. this is a SDK + infra interaction. SDK currently refreshes on 401 immediately; because create returns 202 we end up retrying quickly and hitting transient 502s / rate limits. we should treat 202-provisioning + 401 on firstcall as transient and backoff longer.

sam: short workaround for users: wait until console shows the workspace as 'active' or poll `GET /v1/workspaces/{id}` until status == active. alternatively seed a billing method for the org to skip the webhook delay.

alyssa: totally — the quickstart doc just runs `npm run start` and expects hello-world. new users will be confused. can we add a note?

michael: opened a docs ticket and a small PR to add a visible 'provisioning' step and recommended wait/poll logic: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/402 (WIP)

ida: infra pushed a hotfix to retry billing webhook deliveries and expedite stuck pending workspaces. try re-running in ~2m and ping if still blocked.

alyssa: re-ran after 3m, workspace flipped to active and firstcall succeeded. leaving this thread for docs + SDK backlog. :tada: 

michael: for SDK backlog: add detection for create->202 + subsequent 401/502 on firstcalls, surface telemetry tag `onboard_pending`, and implement exponential backoff (start 1s -> 2s -> 5s) before surfacing a hard error to the app.

sam: added a staging quickstart update to include polling snippet and a short note about billing webhook delays. cc @docs-team
